philosophy.subtitle: PHILOSOPHY
philosophy.title: Designing homes with light, air, and natural materials.
philosophy.quote: We design homes that bring in natural light, fresh air, and peaceful green views every day.
philosophy.p1: In Kerala's tropical climate, traditional houses used central open courtyards to let fresh breeze flow through every room, keeping the home cool naturally.
philosophy.p2: At Dakshina Architects, we bring this traditional wisdom into modern homes. We use local clay tiles, natural wood, and lime plaster to build simple, peaceful living spaces.
philosophy.p3: Your home should be your peaceful sanctuary. Our layouts make every room easy to move through, filled with light, and connected to garden greenery.

manifesto.subtitle: MANIFESTO
manifesto.title: Houses built with natural light, fresh air, and quality wood
manifesto.description: Our designs work naturally with Alappuzha's coastal wind and climate. By combining strong modern construction with traditional open courtyards, we build houses that stay comfortable all year round.

workflow.subtitle: OUR STEP-BY-STEP WORKFLOW
workflow.title: How We Work With You
workflow.description: A transparent 4-stage architectural journey ensuring your project is completed on time and within budget.
workflow.phase1Desc: We inspect your plot in person or review your site survey, discuss your budget, timeline, room requirements, and lifestyle needs.
workflow.phase2Desc: We draft 2D floor plans and 3D exterior elevations optimized for Kerala's sun path, wind flow, and courtyard breezes.
workflow.phase3Desc: We prepare official sanction drawings for local Kerala Panchayat / Municipal approval and finalize structural engineering details.
workflow.phase4Desc: We conduct site visits during key construction stages to ensure quality craftsmanship, correct material finish, and accurate execution.

hero.subtitle: DAKSHINA ARCHITECTS
hero.title: About Dakshina Architects
hero.description: We build thoughtful, climate-friendly homes designed around nature, comfort, and local materials.

philosophy.quote: We design homes that bring in natural light, fresh air, and peaceful green views every day.
philosophy.p1: Traditional houses in Kerala were built to handle heavy rain and hot sun. Builders created open inner courtyards and raised stone floors so air could move freely through every room.
philosophy.p2: At Dakshina Architects, we adapt this smart traditional design to modern homes. We focus on clean layouts, warm teak wood, natural clay tiles, and breathable wall finishes.
philosophy.p3: Your home should be your peaceful sanctuary. Our layouts make every room easy to move through, filled with light, and connected to garden greenery.

pillars.subtitle: DESIGN PRINCIPLES
pillars.title: Our 3 Design Rules
pillars.p1Desc: Block harsh direct sun and catch natural breezes. We position windows and high roofs so your house stays cool naturally without running heavy AC all day.
pillars.p2Desc: Using materials that last for generations: natural clay roof tiles, local granite stone, lime plaster wall finishes, and solid teak wood.
pillars.p3Desc: Simple, beautiful layouts with built-in storage and open spaces that make living calm, orderly, and comfortable.

masonry.subtitle: LOCAL CRAFTSMANSHIP
masonry.title: Local Artisans & Craftsmen
masonry.p1: Every home built by Dakshina Architects is crafted in partnership with skilled local masons, carpenters, and wood artisans across Kerala.
masonry.p2: By working directly with local craftsmen, we support traditional woodworking and stone skills while ensuring your home is built with top-quality custom finish.
